lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Semi-rectilinear arrangement of high-luminance circular pixel clusters posterior to the branchial slits, forming approximately five identifiable horizontal rows.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersecting with horizontal blob rows to form a grid-like structure, most discernible in the mid-lateral region.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal ridges on the upper flank showing a sharp vertical luminance gradient with highlights on the superior edge and shadows on the inferior edge.

other_distinctive_markers: High-density concentration of small luminance blobs on the dorsal surface of the primary pectoral fin; presence of an elongated high-luminance feature attached to the mid-lateral flank.
